decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed Change of Use from offices (B1) to a sports therapy and massage clinic (D1), operating between 8am to 10pm Monday to Friday and between 10am to 8pm Saturday and Sunday is considered acceptable as it complies with the relevant policies in the Hounslow Borough Council Unitary Development Plan 2003 and supplementary planning guidance.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the hours of 0900 hours to 2200 hours Monday to Friday, and 1000 hours to 2000 hours Saturday and Sunday.

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
description: Change of use of 1st floor from B1 (Offices) to D1.
